name: supervisor-kill-failed

graded_by.test: worker/tests/test_supervisor.py — kill_worker SIGKILLs and reaps the worker, and answers only after the reap

description: A worker that will not die (Contract §4; session model §11): the process outlives SIGKILL past reap_timeout — stuck in the kernel, say — and the supervisor answers kill_failed, unkillable. The core raises the operator alert worker_unkillable, which says the process may still hold its target connections; the sessions still end terminated / worker_lost. Restarting the worker container is the operator's, out of band — never TSB's.
